topics.name: Phases of mitosis
topics.summary: Prophase, metaphase, anaphase and telophase, and what happens to the chromosomes in each.

items.prompt: A drug lets the chromosomes line up at the equator but stops the spindle fibres from shortening. Where does the cell get stuck, and what never happens?
items.answer: It stops at metaphase: the chromatids are never pulled to opposite poles, so anaphase never starts.
items.explanation: The fibres pulling the chromatids apart is what anaphase is.
